title: Letters A to Z

parent.learn: English has 26 letters, in a fixed order A to Z.
parent.why: The order matters for later — dictionaries, names on lists — and makes “what comes next” questions possible.

parent.learn: Point to each letter while singing the ABC song.
parent.why: Singing alone blurs “L-M-N-O-P” into one sound; pointing joins each sung name to one letter shape.

parent.learn: Know letters out of order, not just in the song.
parent.why: In books letters are mixed up, so the child must recognise M by its shape, not by where it comes in the song.

parent.learn: Watch out for look-alikes: M and W, N and Z, E and F.
parent.why: Some letters are the same shape turned or with a line missing; noticing the difference is real reading skill.

parent.learn: Vowels: A, E, I, O, U.
parent.why: Almost every English word has one of these. Class 1 uses them to read words like c-a-t.

ask: Sing the ABC song while pointing at the letters.
Find the letter that starts your name.
Spot the letter M on a packet or a sign.
Write the letters A to E.
What is the last letter of the alphabet?
Which letters are in the word MAMA?

rounds.t: Which one is the letter A?
rounds.h: A looks like a pointed roof with a bar across.

rounds.t: Which one is the letter M?
rounds.h: M has two pointed tops, like two hills. W is M upside down.

rounds.t: What is the first letter of the alphabet?
rounds.h: The alphabet starts A, B, C…

rounds.t: What is the last letter of the alphabet?
Which one is the letter S?
rounds.h: S curves like a snake. 5 is a number, not a letter.
A, B, C — C comes right after B.
…C, D, E — D is just before E.

rounds.t: Which letter is between G and I?
rounds.h: G, H, I — H is in the middle.
…Q, R, S — S comes after R.

rounds.t: What is missing? A B C ___ E
rounds.h: A, B, C, D, E — the gap is D.

rounds.t: How many letters are in the English alphabet?
rounds.h: A to Z is 26 letters. Count them while singing the song.
…L, M, N — N comes after M.
…R, S, T — S is just before T.

rounds.t: Which comes first in the alphabet: P or K?
rounds.h: …J, K, L, M, N, O, P. K comes before P.
The vowels are A, E, I, O, U. E is one of them.
